text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 6629 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. There shall be established under the Department of Education and Culture, an agro-industrial college
in the municipality of Burauen, Province of Leyte, to be known as Don Vicente Orestes Romualdez
Agricultural College: Provided, however, That only a general education curriculum with practical arts shall be
offered in the first and second years, and the voca-education curriculum with practical arts shall be offered in
the third and fourth years: Provided, finally, That the school shall offer short vocational courses for training in
vocations needed in the locality which shall be open to elementary school graduates: Provided, finally, That
the school shall be open as soon as feasible, two-year post secondary technical courses. The site of the said
school shall be determined by the Secretary of Education and Culture, upon the recommendation of the
Regional Director, Region VIII, DEC, Tacloban City."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
